key: indagare|remote ai product manager llm personalization
title: Remote AI Product Manager - LLM & Personalization
jd_excerpt:
Indagare is seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the Indagare AI, a proprietary engine built on our travel expertise, member insights, and global partner network. The ideal candidate will own the vision, roadmap, and performance of the engine and the AI-powered experiences it enables, from internal tools for our Travel Desk and Trip Designers to member-facing trip planning.

This is a fully remote, U.S. based position with an annual salary of $120,000. You will report to a VP of Product.

Qualifications
• 5+ years of product management, including 2+ years building AI/ML or LLM-powered products.
• Hands-on understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, embeddings, and AI evaluation methods.
• Experience working with data pipelines and structured and unstructured datasets.
• Proficient in data analysis (SQL, Google Analytics) and able to make data-driven decisions.

Responsibilities
• Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Indagare AI.
• Translate member and trip designer needs into AI use cases, requirements, and prioritized features.
• Partner with engineering, data, and external development partners on model selection and workflows.
• Own the data strategy behind the model, including curation and governance of training and retrieval data.
• Establish evaluation frameworks to measure model quality (accuracy, relevance, tone, personalization).
• Oversee the full AI product lifecycle from prototyping to rollout and iteration.
• Ensure the model reflects Indagare’s voice and editorial standards.
• Define guardrails for responsible AI, including privacy and data security.
• Gather and analyze user feedback to improve outputs and UX.
• Communicate status, milestones, and performance metrics with stakeholders.
• Define and track KPIs for model performance and business impact.
